preconditions.description: The number of tests is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of ladders and snakes is between 1 and 15, inclusive.
Each ladder starts and ends on a square between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each snake starts and ends on a square between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Neither the start nor the end of a ladder is square 1 or 100.
Neither the start nor the end of a snake is square 1 or 100.

preconditions.expression: ladders[i][0] != ladders[j][0] for all i != j
preconditions.description: No two ladders start on the same square.

preconditions.expression: snakes[i][0] != snakes[j][0] for all i != j
preconditions.description: No two snakes start on the same square.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of rolls to reach square 100, or -1 if it's not possible.
